observations: Equivalent warm verification was 90.7 percent faster than the prebuilt no-receipt cold invocation.
Changed and restored source required approximately 72 to 75 seconds of rebuilding; CTest itself took approximately 0.14 seconds.
Restoration executed once because the verifier fails closed against the newest changed-HEAD receipt instead of falling back to older success.
The hosted result exposed a Linux receipt-display path separator defect; commit following this receipt replaced the literal backslash with platform-aware joining.
boundary: This proves the recorded fmt CMake/CTest plan under the tracked source, selected environment, toolchain fingerprints, and enumerated dynamic libraries; it is not a universal C++ correctness claim.
